walls.note: Scherpenheuvel c.1650: the seven-sided enceinte with moat laid out by Wenceslas Cobergher around the basilica (town plan 1603-09, basilica consecrated 1627), traced from the Ferraris map (1777). Local metres around the basilica (x east, z south). Gate names: Dutch for the Ferraris labels.

landmarks.y1650: Baroque pilgrimage church by Wenceslas Cobergher, consecrated 1627, in the centre of the seven-sided town of 1603-09; served by the Oratorians from 1624.
